request.prompt: Scene: the Bell Tower Stair, near view at a player's eye height, dusk, rain through arrow slits. A square stone tower hall with a broad stair climbing around its walls toward a trapdoor far above. Fallen bell rope coils on the floor. On the lowest step lies a second curved shard of the bronze bell, faintly humming with pale light. Behind the viewer, a heavy iron-bound door with a large keyhole stands open.
